provenance.asset_description: Pathfinder Second Edition NPC Core Battle Cards. A mock up of the card box featuring three characters on the front. The First in a pale skinned, dark haired, knight dressed in gold colored armor with a red cape. The Second is a tanned skinned courtesan wearing a puffy, highly decorated dress and large floral sunhat. The third is a a tan skinned woman with silvery armor and decorated gold and white prosthetic arm and eye.
